entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: All right! Now, this is all on me today!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: No holding back—eat as much as you[n]please!
Thanks for the food![clr 27]
Self-control much?
This is quite the spread.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Mmhm! Dig in!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Although... Maybe I went a bit overboard[n]for my first trip? Hahaha...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: S-Sorry. Maybe I went a bit overboard[n]for my first trip? Hahaha...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Hahaha! Well, all the dishes looked[n]so delicious, but... I guess I went a bit[n]overboard?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, right! Sorry, would you mind if[n]I asked you about something before[n]we eat?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It's about my paper...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...Shibusawa?

entries.speaker: Man Called Shibusawa
entries.en: Huh? Maruki!?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I knew it! Shibusawa, in the flesh!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: What are you doing here?

entries.speaker: Man Called Shibusawa
entries.en: That's my line. It's rare to see you[n]in a restaurant like this one.

entries.speaker: Man Called Shibusawa
entries.en: ...Oh? And who might this be?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, he's, uhhh... how do I put it?
I'm his pupil.
It's complicated...
We've made a deal.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Man Called Shibusawa
entries.en: Pupil...? Are you teaching now[n]or something?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: No, not exactly... Anyway, this is[n][lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Shibusawa.

entries.speaker: Man Called Shibusawa
entries.en: Wait, why ARE you hanging out with a[n]high schooler?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: No no, we're not just hanging out here![n]Anyway, this is [lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Shibusawa.

entries.speaker: Man Called Shibusawa
entries.en: A... deal? Not over anything shady, is it?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ahaha, no, not at all. Anyway, this is[n][lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Shibusawa.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Shibusawa was one of my colleagues[n]back in college.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: He's the one who recommended[n]I pursue a counseling career.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: And I hear it's been doing you some[n]good, too. I catch wind of your[n]goings-on every so often.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Honestly, it's a big relief. You have so[n]much more compassion than most,[n]but you can also be a bit too carefree.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You didn't have to mention that[n]part—not that I can refute it...

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: But anyway! Tell me more about how[n]you've been—fill me in on this guy too!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, uh, but aren't you here with others?[n]What about them?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Eh, it's fine—we just happened to swing[n]by here. They won't mind my being[n]away for a bit.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: And do you think you two are really[n]gonna be able to tackle all that food[n]on your own?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: What? Oh... Right.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: So you're a student at Shujin Academy,[n][lName]-kun? They've been on the[n]news an awful lot this year.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: And that's where you're counseling[n]now?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yeah. But only part-time.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: So what are you two doing out at a place[n]like this? This isn't some kind of private[n]counseling session, right?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: He's, well... He's been giving me a hand[n]with my research.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I just brought him here as a thank-you[n]for all his help.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: ...Research?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I had meant to mention this earlier, but...[n]my paper is finally almost finished.
Congratulations.[clr 27]
Way to go.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Mm, it's all thanks to you, though.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Paper? The one you were doing research[n]for... You mean you're still...?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yep... I'm still at it. Even after all of[n]what went down.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You remember what I told you? That[n]I'd finish this paper no matter how long[n]it took me.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Maruki...

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Hahaha! You blow my mind sometimes![n]I swear, you've gotta be the most[n]stubborn man in the world!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Is that supposed to be a compliment?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And anyway, it's not 100% complete yet.[n]I haven't even begun the peer review[n]process.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Oh, seriously? I'd be more than happy[n]to review it for you.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: I mean, I did perform all the peer reviews[n]for your publications in college!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Huh? Really!?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Of course, man, why not? In fact, that's[n]it—this is now officially a celebration![n]The meal's on me today!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, I couldn't do that. I'm supposed to[n]be treating [lName]-kun today...

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Oh, don't worry so much. Don't you[n]wanna congratulate him too,[n][lName]-kun?
I sure do.[clr 27]
Let's celebrate.[clr 27]
I don't care who pays.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: See? He's up for it too.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I-I do appreciate it, but I have to say,[n]I have mixed feelings about this...

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: See, you heard the man. He agrees[n]with me!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Is that what that was...?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Oh, don't sweat the details!

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: C'mon, let's go for a second round.[n]We've gotta hit up the meat section![n]And the vegetables. And the beans!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Whew, what a feast... I think I've hit[n]my caloric intake for the entire week.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Yeah... Maaan, am I gonna get an earful[n]for piling on the pounds.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Hm? By who?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: My girlfriend— Well, my fiancée to be[n]more exact. I'm getting married soon.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, I see...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Wait— Married!?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Yep, married! Now you're the only one[n]left from school who's still flying solo.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Sorry to pry, but I feel like I need to ask...[n]Are you still...?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: ...Actually, forget I said anything.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You were going to ask about Rumi, right?[n]Don't worry, it's fine.
She a girlfriend of yours?
Who's Rumi?
Should I leave you two to talk?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yeah... Former girlfriend, to be precise.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: She was my girlfriend back when I was[n]still a student.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It's okay, there's no need. Rumi was[n]my girlfriend back when I was still[n]a student.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, I was just too spineless at the time,[n]and we broke up in the end.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I-It's not like it's a tragedy or anything,[n]though! She's totally happy now!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It's just that... I don't feel ready to enter[n]another relationship of that sort right[n]now.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Heh... This was supposed to be[n]a celebration, yet I've thoroughly[n]killed the mood. Sorry about that.

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: No, no, it's my bad for bringing it up[n]in the first place. Why don't we wrap[n]things up here?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: I have to say, it's really good to see you[n]doing well—and with your paper almost[n]finished, too!

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Hey, [lName]-kun. Keep an eye on[n]this guy for me, all right?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: I mean, it's pretty rare to see him[n]open up to someone like he has[n]with you.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You're talking about me like I'm some[n]sullen kid...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But I do need to express my appreciation[n]properly.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thank you so much for helping someone[n]like me make their dream come true,[n][lName]-kun.
I can sense Maruki's[n]intense trust in me...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, should we get going?

entries.speaker: Shibusawa
entries.en: Don't forget to send me that paper,[n]okay? I'm seriously going to review it[n]for you.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Haha, I won't. I'll be in touch soon.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thanks for spending some time with[n]me. Make sure you're careful on the[n]way home.
